title: Blitz: multiplayer space shoot-em-up
author: sw3d
selftext:
Looking for feedback and players\*\*\* for my space-themed multiplayer roguelike growth battle arena! Heavily inspired by [slither.io](http://slither.io) and classic asteroids-style arcade games.

I've been building and iterating on this for as few weeks, conducted some small private playtests with friends and now ready to expand to a broader audience!

Here are some reasons you should try it:

* **Jump right in**: free, no signup, no ads, no waiting for lobbies or respawns, works on mobile or desktop, with or without other players (bots fill in)
* **Simple, fast-paced, fun mechanics:** space shoot-em-up + eat crystals to grow/evolve
* **Infinite playstyles**: your choice of 3 secondary weapons, 9 ultimates, 10 different upgrade tracks with 50+ unique upgrades, 2 game modes
* **Optimized for performance**: netcode on binary message format with delta encoding and per-client spatial pruning, 60Hz Rust server/simulator, low-level rendering (PixiJS, close to raw WebGL**)**
* **Badass soundtrack**: EDM/chiptune/dubstep/drum-and-bass mix (feel free to mute if its not your thing)

  
Still iterating on graphics, audio, and balance -- also hoping to scale this to 500-player lobbies (as slither did after they launched almost 10 years ago!) Feedback welcome, good or bad 🙏 

\*\*\*there is only one server on us/east for now; you can play from anywhere but us/east players will have the best experience / lowest latency

comments.author: UndercoverBirb
comments.body:
Ooh I recently got back into Slither.io! I've been a huge fan of that game for years, so I was curious to try out yours. I'm a major Reddit lurker but am really enjoying what you've put together so far, so I wanted to leave some feedback! This is all just my personal opinion of course, feel free to take it or leave it. (Also sorry in advance for the wall of text. I am a windbag. 😭)



So far my best score is 6:40 time survived, 42 ships downed, lvl 34. Died shortly after the boss spawned because I flew too close and caught aggro. Was bummed cuz I almost killed it too haha.



It took me a bunch of deaths with a survival time of \~7sec to start getting the hang of it (I was playing on mobile when I realized I had no way to use secondary fire from my tablet) and in the process I found myself \*really\* wishing there was a solo mode so that I could take a moment to just read the upgrades text (the text is tiny) and see what the different abilities were without instantly dying lol. It felt like the bots would just make a beeline for me the moment I spawned and gave me zero time to get oriented / try to read the tiny text / etc. At the very least I wished that I wouldn't spawn seemingly \*right\* next to an enemy. There were multiple times I'd spawn in and a larger ship was already right next to me, so that was kind of frustrating, lol.

  
I thought having the minimap combined with the direction controls was clever for saving some mobile screen space, although my thumb blocks it quite a bit and I wish it was easier to tell which dot is mine. That didn't feel like too big of a deal once I hit a size that zoomed my camera way out though. I was otherwise fairly impressed with how the controls felt on mobile, because I usually hate how clunky it feels, but in this case I loved that the primary and secondary buttons were so close together that I could keep pressing both with one finger haha.

  
After I got the hang of how to play, it became very, very fun. It's super satisfying gunning down ships much larger than me, getting into strafe/bullet dodging duels, and I really enjoyed testing different upgrade builds. There are tons of times when I'm too tired to do something more active and watching something is too passive, so games like yours hit a great sweet spot. They're the kind of thing I like coming back to and that I can easily sink a bunch of hours into over time. Once I'm back at my desktop I imagine I'll enjoy playing this even more, lol.

  
But yeah, excited to see where you take it! An eventual possible 500-player lobby sounds like some fun insanity haha.

replies.author: sw3d
replies.body:
Thanks for that review man really appreciate you :) glad you liked it, a 500 player lobby would be insane! I have a lot of scaling challenges to solve till then but it will be a fun ride. I'll consider how to improve the mobile experience (something I've been iterating on for a while as I do want to have a great mobile and desktop exp) and a tutorial / solo mode (though right now not many players so it's often a solo lobby with bots XD)

Would be great to have you in future play tests, add me on DM :)
